priorStatuses.title: Handle missing cache entries before trimming

findings.title: [P1] Do not write issued tokens to application logs
findings.body: Every call with a live authentication token emits the complete credential to stdout. In environments that collect application logs, anyone with log access could retrieve and replay issued tokens.

findings.title: [P2] Restrict post-login redirects to trusted local URLs
findings.body: location.assign accepts absolute and protocol-relative URLs, so an attacker-controlled returnUrl can redirect an authenticated user to an external phishing site. Validate the destination and permit only same-origin application paths.
